evidence.title: Impact of SLA exposure on data center financing and valuation

summary: New analysis finds that heightened exposure to service‑level‑agreement (SLA) risks is prompting lenders and investors to demand higher financing rates for data‑center projects, which in turn depresses their market valuations. The trend signals a shift toward stricter risk assessments in data‑center financing and could reshape investment strategies across the sector.
title: SLA Risk Exposure Raises Financing Costs and Lowers Valuations for Data Centers
